_comment: GOS custom gates (declarative layer, copied by `gos setup`). Keys: protect = glob blacklist — the gate FAILs when any matched path shows up modified or staged in git; lint = shell command — a non-zero exit FAILs the gate (needs a runnable script in your project); forbid = '<regex> in <path>' entries — git grep hits FAIL. Edit to fit your project; remove keys you do not need.
